title: Steklov Spectral Geometry for Annular Surfaces: Inverse spectral results and isospectral compactness
summary: We study the inverse spectral problems for the Steklov spectrum on compact surfaces with boundary. We prove that among flat annular surfaces, the lateral surface of a conical frustum is uniquely determined by its Steklov spectrum. As a consequence, each circular annulus is uniquely determined among all planar domains, providing the first example of a non-simply connected Euclidean domain with this property. Furthermore, we show that any family of Steklov isospectral flat annular surfaces is compact in the $C^\infty$ topology, extending previous results for simply connected planar domains.…
